Three radical approaches to the booth converge this Friday night in Astin 💫

Headlining the night is @skeemask_official, a key figure on the Ilian Tape roster and the producer behind landmark albums like Compro. The Munich-based artist’s sound moves between techno, breaks and ambient, drawing on the legacy of 90s UK dance culture.

Back at the club is Dutch DJ and radio host DJ Marcelle. With a collection of over 20,000 vinyl records and her unmistakable three-turntable setup, she delivers unpredictable sonic collages where cutting-edge techno, dub, African and Caribbean rhythms, and punk collide.

Completing the lineup is Barcelona-based Argentine DJ @imox_x, whose sound spans deep techno, bass music and breaks, alongside more introspective sounds.

Born in Guatemala and based in Barcelona, Brizas has built a beautiful journey through the electronic scene, blending deep house, house and deep tech with elegance, emotion and groove.
Co-founder of Mise en Place and a regular presence at iconic venues such as Pacha, Input, La Terrazza and Macarena Club, as well as festivals like Brunch Electronik, she has shared the booth with artists including Black Coffee, Hernán Cattáneo, Desiree, Giorgia Angiuli, Route 94, &ME, Adam Port and Recondite.

Her sets are all about the journey. Emotional, hypnotic and atmospheric, guided by a versatility and a sublime taste for electronic music that transform every dancefloor into a space for connection.
